key_insight: GDSW-type coarse spaces support scalable high-order 3D domain decomposition, but VEM requires moment-based kernel representation to retain coarse-level effectiveness for polynomial degrees k ≥ 3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners support efficient parallel finite element and virtual element simulations, including 3D linear elasticity.
method: Use two-level overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW, GDSW*, or reduced GDSW coarse spaces.
Represent operator kernels through face moments when constructing VEM coarse basis functions.
Evaluate high-order FEM and VEM for Poisson and linear elasticity problems.
evidence_signal: Tests reached polynomial degree k = 5 and 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all coarse-space variants and extension of the moment-based construction to elasticity.
watch_item: VEM coarse-space construction is not purely algebraic: omitting the face-moment correction makes the coarse level ineffective for k ≥ 3.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
